Inter-State Athletics Championships conclude with strong performances

The National Inter-State Athletics Championships have concluded, featuring notable performances in javelin and long jump. Athletes like Rohit Yadav and Sreeshankar showcased their skills, while Jyothi Yarraji also made a significant return to the track. The event highlighted emerging talent and established athletes in Indian athletics.
